The '''''Empire Maker''''' was a [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] built by the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] that served as [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Drikl Lecersen]]'s [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] at the [[Battle over Exodo II]].
